prompt: Luxury watch commercial, final hero shot about time. A gentle breeze makes very fine golden sand grains slide and flow softly down the dune around the watch, like an hourglass; the low sunset light glows; the camera slowly pushes in. The watch does not move and stays exactly identical: same dial, sub-dials, numbers, bezel, case and strap. Keep large empty dark space at the top and bottom. Single continuous shot, no cuts. No smoke, no text, no logo, no people, no hands.
